about: Hugging Face Hub (huggingface.co): search and inspect public models, datasets, Spaces and organizations, read model/dataset metadata, file listings, security scans and dataset statistics, without logging in.

commands.summary: Search and filter Hub models by keyword, task, library, app, parameter count, inference provider or license, with sorting and pages

params.name: pipeline_tag
params.description: Task filter, e.g. text-generation, image-text-to-text, text-to-image, any-to-any, text-to-speech

params.name: library
params.description: Library or format filter, e.g. transformers, pytorch, tf, safetensors, gguf

params.name: apps
params.description: Compatible local app, e.g. llama.cpp, vllm

params.name: num_parameters
params.description: Parameter-count range as min:X,max:Y with B/M suffixes, e.g. min:0,max:6B

params.name: inference_provider
params.description: Only models served by this inference provider, e.g. novita, nscale

params.name: license
params.description: License tag id in the form license:<name>, e.g. license:apache-2.0 (see list-model-tags)

commands.summary: Autocomplete-style quick search that returns matching models, datasets, Spaces, orgs and users together
Full-text search inside model, dataset or Space cards (README content), with highlighted matches

params.name: q
params.description: Text to search for in repository cards

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: List all model license tag ids (e.g. license:apache-2.0) usable in search-models --license
Get full public metadata for a model: tags, downloads, likes, config, card data, file list (siblings), parameter counts, gating

params.name: owner
params.description: Model owner (user or org), the part of the model id before '/'

params.name: name
params.description: Model repo name, the part of the model id after '/'

commands.summary: Get the security (malware/pickle) scan status of a model repository's files
List files on a model repository's main branch with sizes, last commit message, date and download links
Download the raw text of a file from a model repository's main branch, e.g. README.md or config.json

params.name: file
params.description: File name in the repo root, as listed by list-model-files, e.g. README.md, config.json

commands.summary: Search and filter Hub datasets by keyword, modality and format, with sorting and pages

params.name: modality
params.description: Modality filter in the form modality:<x>, e.g. modality:text, modality:image, modality:audio, modality:tabular, modality:video, modality:3d

params.name: format
params.description: File format filter in the form format:<x>, e.g. format:json, format:csv, format:parquet

commands.summary: Get a dataset's Croissant metadata (name, description, license, splits, fields, file distribution) from its page
Get the security scan status of a dataset repository's files
Check which dataset-viewer features (viewer, preview, search, filter, statistics) are available for a dataset split

params.name: split
params.description: Split name, e.g. train, test, validation

commands.summary: Get per-column statistics (types, null counts, unique values, label frequencies, length histograms) for a dataset split
Search Hugging Face Spaces (AI demo apps) by keyword, with sorting
List the repositories shown in an organization's or user's profile collections (models and datasets with stats)
